description: This Java source file defines the GetOpt class, which provides command-line argument parsing functionality supporting both legacy (-x) and modern (--argument) styles, including usage printing and argument validation.

classes.name: GetOpt
classes.description: A utility class for parsing command-line options supporting legacy and modern styles, with methods for argument parsing, usage display, and option validation.

methods.name: getopts
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments using either legacy string format or a list of GetOpt options, returning a list of GetOpt objects with associated arguments.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the provided options, supporting both legacy and modern styles.
